note: Public SaaS repositories used to measure discovery heuristics. Commits are pinned so a heuristic change shows as a report diff rather than corpus drift. `declaresPricing` records what a human confirmed by reading the repository. `planValues` stands in for a synced Stripe catalog and is taken from each repository's own plan enum or its observed plan literals, never invented.

repositories.name: dub
repositories.why: Link shortener SaaS. Declares plans and Stripe price IDs in packages/utils/src/constants/pricing/.

repositories.name: papermark
repositories.why: Document sharing SaaS. Carries Stripe price identifiers in code.

repositories.name: twenty
repositories.why: CRM. Large monorepo, useful as a scale case as well as a pricing case.

repositories.name: documenso
repositories.why: Reads pricing from Stripe rather than declaring it. Finding nothing here is the correct outcome.

repositories.name: formbricks
repositories.why: Survey SaaS with plan tiers but no price identifiers in code.

repositories.name: unkey
repositories.why: API key management SaaS. Usage-based billing without price identifiers in code.
